sn41.7:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā godatto macchikāsaṇḍe viharati ambāṭakavane.
sn41.7:1.2: atha kho citto gahapati yenāyasmā godatto tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ godattaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho cittaṃ gahapatiṃ āyasmā godatto etadavoca:
sn41.7:1.3: yā cāyaṃ gahapati appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti yā ca suññatā cetovimutti yā ca animittā cetovimutti. ime dhammā nānatthā nānā vyañjanā? udāhu ekatthā vyañjanameva nānanti?
sn41.7:1.4: atthi bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānāvyañjanā ca.
sn41.7:1.5: atthi pana bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā vyañjanameva nānanti.
sn41.7:2.1: katamo ca bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānāvyañjanā ca:
sn41.7:2.2: idha bhante bhikkhu mettāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ, iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
sn41.7:2.5: upekkhāsahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthiṃ. iti uddhamadho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekkhāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena abyāpajjena pharitvā viharati.
sn41.7:3.2: idha bhante bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma, natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn41.7:4.2: idha bhante bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisaṃcikkhati
sn41.7:5.2: idha bhante bhikkhu sabbanimittānaṃ amanasikārā animittaṃ ceto samādhiṃ upasampajja viharati.
sn41.7:5.4: ayaṃ kho bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā nānatthā ceva nānāvyañjanā ca.
sn41.7:6.1: katamo ca bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā vyañjanameva nānaṃ:
sn41.7:6.2: rāgo kho bhante pamāṇakaraṇo doso pamāṇakaraṇo moho pamāṇakaraṇo.
sn41.7:6.3: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn41.7:6.4: yāvatā kho bhante appamāṇā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggamakkhāyati.
sn41.7:6.5: sā kho panākuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena suññā dosena suññā mohena.
sn41.7:6.6: rāgo kho bhante kiñcanaṃ doso kiñcanaṃ moho kiñcanaṃ.
sn41.7:6.7: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn41.7:6.8: yāvatā kho bhante ākiñcaññā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggamakkhāyati;
sn41.7:6.9: sā kho panākuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena suññā dosena suññā mohena.
sn41.7:6.10: rāgo kho bhante nimittakaraṇo doso nimittakaraṇo moho nimittakaraṇo.
sn41.7:6.11: te khīṇāsavassa bhikkhuno pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
sn41.7:6.12: yāvatā kho bhante animittā cetovimuttiyo akuppā tāsaṃ cetovimutti aggamakkhāyati;
sn41.7:6.13: sā kho panākuppā cetovimutti suññā rāgena suññā dosena suññā mohena.
sn41.7:6.14: ayaṃ kho bhante pariyāyo yaṃ pariyāyaṃ āgamma ime dhammā ekatthā vyañjanameva nānanti.
sn41.7:6.16: yassa te gambhīre buddhavacane paññācakkhu kamatīti.
